003_p: Notice what's in the light, what's in the shadow, and what it takes to shift.
006_p: Two residential days for a circle of women — a pattern IN keeps returning to, reshaped for whoever it meets.
007_p: The pattern is simple to say and slow to live. Everything in the two days is a different door into the same question, and nothing in it is separate from anything else — one continuous conversation, carried by hands as much as words.
009_p: Women hold a great deal for other people. This is two days of holding something for yourself.
010_p: Time to name what you are carrying, in a circle of women doing the same, and to leave with a pledge that is yours rather than assigned — written up on a shared wall so it is witnessed.

041_p: The three words hold whatever length you have. We set the balance of drawing, walking, writing, and stillness with you beforehand — and if your group would rather work in one language, or mostly in silence, we build it that way.
